caption:
Tokyo Christmas Market: 5 things to know 🎄
Shiba Park, under Tokyo Tower, 4–25 Dec 2026.
Save this before you go.

1️⃣ It isn't free
🎟️ ¥1,000 on weekdays, ¥1,500 at weekends.

2️⃣ Tickets are timed
⏱️ 30-minute slots on KKday or at FamilyMart.
📅 Same-day entry can be limited: book weekends ahead.

3️⃣ The red mug
☕ It comes free with an advance adult ticket.
🔁 Refills cost only the drink.

4️⃣ Get off at Onarimon
🚇 Exit A6, about 1 minute.
⚠️ Not Shibakoen Station.

5️⃣ Go on a weekday afternoon
🌤️ The quietest time.
💴 24–25 Dec cost ¥2,000 and are the busiest.
